title: Associate - NDFA Construction, Asset Management
description: **Job Title: Associate –** **NDFA – Construction & Asset Management** **Division/Function: National Development Framework Authority** **Contract Type: 23 Month FTC** **Commencement Date: September 2027** * Closing Date for Applications: 10th December 2026 \*\*\*\* **Summary of the Business:** The National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) provides asset and liability management services to the Irish Government. It has evolved from a single function agency managing the National Debt to a manager of a complex portfolio of public assets and liabilities. Businesses managed by the NTMA include borrowing on behalf of the Government and the management of the National Debt, the State Claims Agency, the New Economy and Recovery Authority (“NewERA”), the Ireland Strategic Investment Fund, National Development Finance Agency and the NTMA Future Ireland Funds business unit with responsibility for the management of the Future Ireland Fund and Infrastructure, Climate and Nature Fund. The NTMA also assigns staff to the Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland (SBCI) and Home Building Finance Ireland (HBFI). **Role Summary:** This is an exciting opportunity for talented and motivated graduates to join the **NDFA unit (** **Construction & Asset Management)** on a 23-month Associate Programme commencing in September 2027. The programme is open to graduates with a degree in **Engineering, Construction Studies,** **Quantity Surveying, Project Management, Architecture, building systems and energy management or other building related discipline** **.** **Business Unit Summary:** The NDFA provides financial advice to State authorities on infrastructure projects with a capital value over €75 million and is also responsible for the delivery of Public Private Partnership (PPP) projects for State authorities (with certain exceptions such as Transport Infrastructure Ireland). In addition, the NDFA provides asset management services in respect of the operation and maintenance of PPP facilities. It also delivers Exchequer Funded capital projects on behalf of certain State authorities, including the Department of Education and Youth and certain local authorities. Following the publication of the Government’s Accelerating Infrastructure Report and Action Plan the NDFA also provides support and assistance to Government Departments and Agencies on major capital infrastructure projects. The Associate will be required to work alongside all colleagues across the full range of the NDFA ( **Construction & Asset Management** ) activities. The Associate will support the NDFA Construction & Asset Management team through day-to-day duties including but not limited to, the tasks described below: * Construction monitoring activities, including site visits and associated reporting on progress across a portfolio of live construction projects, which can typically include schools, higher education facilities, housing developments and the justice sector. * Contract management services in respect of operational PPP facilities. The NDFA provides contract management services to government client departments and agencies for a range of operational PPP projects similar to those described above. This role involves monitoring the performance of the private sector PPP company to ensure that the facilities are being operated and maintained to the correct standard. It involves site visits and meetings with end users. * Administration and management of project documents on the NDFA’s common data environment * Creation and maintenance of project registers and trackers to ensure accurate records * Preparation of reports, recommendations and presentations * Stakeholder engagement and management At the end of the programme the successful Associate will have developed a solid knowledge base of the **NDFA** unit and the wider NTMA. **Working at the NTMA offers excellent benefits including:** * Competitive salary and 23 days annual leave * Career average defined benefit pension scheme * Education funding and paid study leave * Reimbursement of annual professional membership fees * Excellent learning and development opportunities that allow for full career development within the organisation * Extensive workplace wellbeing programme * State of the art facilities with sustainable modern workspaces * Advanced technology enabling flexible and hybrid work options * A diverse range of initiatives: LGBT+, Gender Matters, Disability Advocacy, Sports & Social, Volunteering and lots more. **Learning and Development:** Typically, Associates within this division are working towards achieving Chartered membership of a relevant professional body and often undertake professional qualifications such as post graduate diplomas / certificates in project management or construction law related areas. They are supported through the full range of NTMA study supports, complemented by a comprehensive Associate Development Programme, an Associate network spanning the NTMA, and extensive on-the-job learning opportunities. **Do you have what it takes?** Are you ambitious, commercially minded and diligent? Do you have what it takes to excel in a challenging, fast-paced team environment? Do you have the flexibility to adapt to different environments and responsibilities? Successful candidates will have a minimum of a 2.1 honours degree or a minimum of a 2.1 Masters, ideally in a related discipline. Applicants must have the correct legal status to work in Ireland (Irish Citizen, EEA Citizen, Stamp 4, Stamp 1G Visa). The NTMA are strong believers in the value a diverse work force brings to our business endeavours. We can accommodate candidates with a disability at every stage of our process. Should you need any additional support, please don’t hesitate to contact our Disability Liaison Officer - Laura Finnegan **Pension Abatement** If an appointee has previously been employed in the Civil or Public Service and that appointee is entitled to or in receipt of a pension from the Civil or Public Service or where a Civil/Public Service pension comes into payment during the appointee’s re-employment that pension will be subject to abatement in accordance with Section 52 of the Public Service Pensions (Single Scheme and other Provisions) Act 2012. wider company **Your profile** **Experience** * No previous experience of media planning is required but an interest in media planning and buying is essential * Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint * High level of business acumen **Person Specification** * Be energetic and efficient in approach * Actively display a passion for the industry * Strong title: Data Automation Graduate
description: **Programme Duration:** 2-Year Graduate Programme **Start Date:** 06 September 2027 **End Date:** 05 September 2029 Role: Data Automation Graduate Team: AI and Automation team, working jointly with the Data and Insights team Reports to: Director for Technology, Solutions and Processes, AI 2. About the Role The Data Automation Graduate helps Uniphar get the most from its data, turning manual, repetitive data tasks into reliable automated processes and using AI to capture and unlock the valuable data that already exists across the business. Working across the AI and Automation team and the Data and Insights team, the graduate builds data pipelines, automated workflows and reports, and explores how AI can extract, organise and surface information held in documents, emails and existing systems. The role helps make sure the Group's data is clean, well governed and ready to power analytics and AI solutions, delivering measurable time savings and better insight for colleagues and customers. 3. Rotations This is not a rotational role. Instead, the graduate will split their time between the AI and Automation team and the Data and Insights team, working on shared projects across all three divisions and the Group head office functions. This gives broad exposure to different users and business areas, and to every stage of the data and automation lifecycle, from requirements and data preparation through build, testing, rollout and adoption. 4. What You Will Learn & Deliver * Learns how to gather business requirements, map processes and understand how data moves through the Group's systems and teams. * Learns how to design, build and maintain automated data pipelines and workflows, using tools such as Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric and SQL, that replace manual data handling and reporting. * Explores how AI can help the Group capture and make better use of the data it already holds, using AI solutions from Microsoft, Anthropic and other business-approved providers, for example to extract information from documents, emails and legacy systems and make it searchable and usable for teams, reports and AI agents. * Develops practical skills in data quality and responsible data and AI practices, working alongside data engineers, analysts and AI developers. * Delivers reliable, well-documented solutions and contributes to measurable business value by reducing manual effort and tracking the time and cost savings achieved. 5. Required Skills & Knowledge * A foundational understanding of, or strong interest in, data concepts such as databases, data modelling, data quality and reporting, and in how AI can be applied to data, with the ability to apply these to real business problems. * Basic programming or querying ability (for example SQL, Python or similar), and an interest in working with APIs, spreadsheets and workflow automation tools. * Analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail, and the ability to spot manual, repetitive data tasks that could be automated. * Clear communication and documentation skills, with the confidence to explain data and technical ideas to non-technical colleagues. * A willingness to learn modern data, automation and AI platforms, including Microsoft tools (Power BI, Power Automate, Fabric, Copilot and Azure AI), Anthropic's Claude and other business-approved AI solutions, and to follow good data governance and data protection (GDPR) practices. 6. Education & Qualifications A third-level degree in any discipline, or equivalent practical experience (placements, internships, project work). We welcome applicants from all backgrounds who can show the skills above; typical degrees include Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Business and Engineering. **Uniphar Background** Uniphar Group is a rapidly expanding diversified healthcare services business with a global footprint and a proud heritage in Ireland. Since Uniphar became a publicly listed company in 2019, the Group has grown organically and through a series of strategic acquisitions, which continue to strengthen Uniphar’s international reach. With a workforce of more than 3,000 spread across Ireland, United Kingdom, Mainland Europe, MENA and the USA, Uniphar is a trusted global partner to pharma and medtech manufacturers, working to improve patient access to medicines and treatments around the world. Uniphar provides outsourced and specialised services to its clients, leveraging the strong relationships with 200+ of the world’s best known pharmaco-medical manufacturers across multiple geographies, enabled by our cutting-edge digital technology and our expert teams. Uniphar is organised into three key divisions: Uniphar Supply Chain & Retail, Uniphar Medtech and Uniphar Pharma ***Please note that Uniphar is an equal-opportunity employer; we do not discriminate and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.*** Please note that all applications must be submitted by the closing date of **3rd January 2027**

title: Graduate AI Agent Developer
description: Location: CityWest Programme Duration: 2-Year Graduate Programme Start Date: 06 September 2027 End Date: 05 September 2029 Role: Graduate AI Agent Developer Team: Product Team Reports to: Director Technology, Solutions and Processes 2. About the Role A Graduate AI Agent Developer supports the design and development of intelligent, automated agents that streamline processes and enhance decision making across the organisation. The role focuses on turning real business problems into scalable AI-driven solutions that deliver measurable efficiency and improved user experiences. Working closely with technical and operational teams, the developer ensures that agents are reliable, compliant, and aligned to organisational goals. This role adds value by accelerating digital transformation 3. Rotations This is not a rotational role, however the graduate will work with teams across all three divisions. This will provide a broad understanding of different users What You Will Learn & Deliver * Learns how to gather practical business requirements and understand the day to day responsibilities of different roles throughout the business. * Learns how to design, build, and refine AI agents that address real operational challenges across the organisation. * Develops practical skills in prompt engineering, data handling, and responsible AI practices while working with experienced teams. * Delivers reliable and well tested AI agents that enhance workflow efficiency and support informed decision making. * Contributes to measurable business value by automating manual processes and improving overall service quality. 5. Required Skills & Knowledge * A foundational understanding/interest in artificial intelligence concepts, including large language models, prompt engineering, data handling, and responsible AI principles, with the ability to apply them in practical scenarios. * Knowledge Basic programming or scripting capability, along with the ability to work with APIs, structured data, and workflow automation tools. * Analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to break down business processes and identify where AI agents can add value. * Good communication and documentation skills, ensuring clear handover of logic, requirements, and agent behaviour to technical and non technical stakeholders. * A willingness to learn modern AI platforms such as Copilot Studio, Azure AI, or equivalent low code and pro code tools, and to stay updated on safe, compliant AI development practices. * undefined6. Education & QualificationsA relevant degree OR equivalent practical experience (placements, internships, project work). For regulated roles, specify accredited programmes as required.Any 3rd level qualification would be suitable if the candidate displayed the desired skills above, however typically you would often see digital development graduates coming from degrees like; Business, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics or Psychology. **Uniphar Background** Uniphar Group is a rapidly expanding diversified healthcare services business with a global footprint and a proud heritage in Ireland. Since Uniphar became a publicly listed company in 2019, the Group has grown organically and through a series of strategic acquisitions, which continue to strengthen Uniphar’s international reach. With a workforce of more than 3,000 spread across Ireland, United Kingdom, Mainland Europe, MENA and the USA, Uniphar is a trusted global partner to pharma and medtech manufacturers, working to improve patient access to medicines and treatments around the world. Uniphar provides outsourced and specialised services to its clients, leveraging the strong relationships with 200+ of the world’s best known pharmaco-medical manufacturers across multiple geographies, enabled by our cutting-edge digital technology and our expert teams. Uniphar is organised into three key divisions: Uniphar Supply Chain & Retail, Uniphar Medtech and Uniphar Pharma ***Please note that Uniphar is an equal-opportunity employer; we do not discriminate and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.*** Please note that all applications must be submitted by the closing date of **3rd January 2027**

title: Graduate Structural Engineer - Belfast/Dublin (2027 start)
description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** Our UK & Ireland business can provide a comprehensive portfolio of multidisciplinary engineering skills, with our structural engineers playing a leading and influential role in the development of building projects. We’re currently engaged in a vast array of building projects from world class sporting venues through to commercial properties, healthcare, higher education and research facilities, hotels and resorts, industrial and manufacturing developments. These projects are located both in the UK and increasingly overseas. Some examples of current projects in the Structural Engineering Practice include: * **RVH Children’s Hospital, Belfast** - AECOM structural engineers are part of a multi-discipline team in the design of the new flagship 10-storey healthcare development which will centralise regional paediatric services for Northern Ireland. This signature project, with 55,000sqm floor area across 10-storeys is currently under construction and when complete will provide 155 inpatient beds, surgical care, as well as emergency and outpatient services. Construction began in March 2025 with an expected completion date of 2030. * **Curragh Racecourse, Ireland** – AECOM provided multi-disciplinary services on the redevelopment of Ireland’s preeminent racecourse- where racing has taken place since 1729. The project included the construction of saddling stalls, museum arm, and its centrepiece, the breath-taking grandstand. With its soaring linear roof, the grandstand can accommodate crowds of up to 10,000 spectators. * **Dublin Airport** – The AECOM Structures Team in Belfast have been engaged to several projects within Dublin Airport, including design of the DAA Capacity Plan, which facilitated the enhanced flow and secure movement of the public through the airport across both T1 & T2 terminals. The structures team have also developed concept proposals for the future Transport Hub at the airport, that will integrate the future transition of bus and metro users to a new modern facility to make connections faster, simpler and more reliable for the traveller. * **Dundonald International Ice Bowl, Belfast** – AECOM are providing full multidisciplinary services for the design and delivery of this new state of the art entertainment, leisure, and health complex currently under construction adjacent to the original 1986 building in East Belfast. Led by Lisburn & Castlereagh City Council, the project includes an Olympic sizes ice rink, 24-lane ten-pin bowling alley,120 station gym, hospitality and outdoor play facilities. It is expected to open in 2027. * **Windsor Park Football Stadium Redevelopment** – The redevelopment of Windsor Park and Olympia Leisure Centre with a combined project cost of approximately £50m, seen AECOM provide building engineering services for the design of a new 18,500 all-seater capacity football stadium and integrated leisure centre, with 25m swimming pool and learner pools as well as associated 120-station gym, multi-purpose sports hall and floodlit sports village. * **Al Janoub Stadium, Qatar** – Inspired by the rich heritage of Qatar and the Al Wakrah region, this 45,000 capacity FIFA 2020 World Cup stadium was designed with the timeless characteristics of simplicity, solidity, pace and light. One of the most technically demanding projects we have ever delivered, including unprecedented advances in the use of Building Information Modelling (BIM). * **Chateau La Coste, Provence** – AECOM structures team in Belfast have provided civil and structural engineering services on several expressive and innovative art galleries and luxury hotels, close to Aix-en-Provence in the south of France. This includes art galleries which been conceived by world renowned artists and architects, including Renzo Piano, Louise Bourgeois and Oscar Niemeyer. Giving the team an opportunity to work on elaborate and challenging projects alongside award-winning and reputable designers. Both Villa La Coste Hotel & Spa and Auberge La Coste offer guests luxury accommodation within a fully operational vineyard and sculpture park, full of modern art exhibits and celebrated architecture. All of our buildings are conceived, designed, and constructed in a collaborative way to ensure they meet the often wide ranging requirements of the client brief, within the constraints of time and budget, all while still performing sustainably. Increasingly, we work with our other internal business lines such as architecture, building services engineering, environment, transportation, project management and cost management to deliver an all-encompassing service to our clients and their projects. We wish to recruit graduates who are enthusiastic about improving the built environments, who can bring that passion and flair to their work, and who want to apply their recently acquired engineering skills to the real world on interesting and impactful projects **Job Responsibilities** As a graduate launching your career with AECOM’s Structural Engineering Practice, you will be placed in a team and paired with an experienced engineer. With support from your wider team, this mentor will guide and support you through the initial stages of your career. Your key responsibilities may include the following: * Assisting in the development of our projects through the different design stages * Developing analytical and design skills * Producing designs, calculations, sketches, diagrams, design intents and final working drawings for various elements of a building structure under the supervision of an experienced engineer * Collecting and analysing data under the supervision of an experienced engineer * Using various tools at your disposal to solve engineering problems * Attending meetings and workshops with other design professionals such as architects * Liaising with other disciplines within the project team to coordinate designs * Performing work in accordance with agreed upon budget and timescales under supervision * Contributing to hazard elimination and reduction * Conducting site visits during the construction phase of projects to inspect the works * Contributing to a wide range of projects as the work load dictates You will start working on live projects almost straight away, as we believe the best way to learn is through real world, on the job experience. This experiential learning will be supplemented with training from a variety of sources specific to the Structural Engineering Practice, as a part of our ICE accredited training scheme. This will include lunchtime training seminars and formal training courses. This training is designed to provide you with a holistic development experience, bridging the gap between university and the world of work. You will be empowered to fulfil your potential, and make a valuable contribution as a structural engineer at AECOM. Some of the topics your training and development will focus on include: * Design methods for various structural elements using a range of structural materials, * Practical application of current design software that allows us deliver design solutions efficiently and effectively * The skills necessary to present our engineering solutions – including sketching and the use of 3D drawing in Revit * Commercial awareness and contracts * Health & Safety This training will ensure you have a full set of design skills and are equipped to engage confidently with the wider design and contractor teams. Through the course of your graduate scheme, you will develop confidence in designing in a variety of structural materials and building types. You will also begin to develop an awareness of commercial arrangements, contract and procurement types, and how they impact our work. and intragroup treasury-related invoices * Preparation and/ or review of monthly management accounts **Operational activities** * To undertake front office activities (i.e. pre-trade counterparty title: Network Operations Analyst
description: **Based on site in Ballsbridge, early mornings and weekend work required** The Network Operations Engineer I is an entry-level technical role. Engineers I monitor, triage and maintain the health of Optical and IP networks in a 24x7 operational environment. This role is the first point of response for network alarms and incidents. It works closely with Network Operations Engineers II, who act as its escalation point, and with Team Leads to restore service and keep the network stable. The role is hands-on and follows defined procedures. Engineers I detect and acknowledge alarms, carry out first-level troubleshooting using established runbooks, open and document tickets, and support scheduled maintenance under guidance. Issues that go beyond first-level diagnosis are escalated promptly to Engineers II with clear initial findings. Engineers I build their skills through structured training, shadowing and mentorship. **Scope** * Serve as the first-level response point for optical and IP network alarms and incidents. * Monitor network health using NOC monitoring and alarm management tools, and acknowledge alarms within defined response times. * Perform first-level triage and troubleshooting following established runbooks and procedures. * Escalate incidents to Network Operations Engineers II with accurate initial diagnostics. * Create, update and maintain tickets with clear, accurate documentation. * Support scheduled maintenance activities and network changes under the direction of senior engineers. * Develop technical knowledge of optical and IP technologies through training, shadowing and mentorship. **Roles and Responsibilities** **Monitoring, Incident Response & First-Level Troubleshooting** * Monitor optical and IP network alarms, events and performance dashboards across a 24x7 environment. * Acknowledge, prioritise and triage alarms and incidents according to severity and defined response times. * Perform first-level troubleshooting of optical (DWDM, CWDM) and IP (IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, BGP, OSPF) networks using runbooks. This includes checking optical power levels, interface status, alarm states, protocol adjacencies and basic connectivity. * Gather initial diagnostic information such as logs, alarm history, interface counters and recent changes to support fault isolation. * Escalate incidents that cannot be resolved at first level to Network Operations Engineers II, with clear findings and the steps already taken. * Support senior engineers during major service-impacting incidents by running checks, gathering data and keeping tickets updated. **Ticket & Case Management** * Create, update and close tickets with accurate, detailed and timely documentation for all work performed. * Open cases with vendor TACs (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera) when directed, and provide the requested logs and diagnostics. * Track open tickets and vendor cases, and follow up to ensure timely progress. * Verify basic service restoration after an incident and record the outcome in the ticket. * Notify internal stakeholders and customers of incidents using approved communication templates. **Maintenance & Change Support** * Support scheduled maintenance activities and network changes under the direction of Engineers II or III, including pre- and post-change checks. * Follow approved method-of-procedure (MOP) documents and change management processes. * Assist with turn-up and testing of new circuits, services and network elements. * Coordinate with field technicians, colocation facilities, ISPs and service providers to arrange access, dispatches and testing. **Learning, Process & Collaboration** * Complete structured training and shadow senior engineers to build optical and IP troubleshooting skills. * Follow runbooks and procedures, and flag gaps or inaccuracies to senior engineers for update. * Contribute to knowledge-base articles under the review of senior engineers. * Participate in shift handoffs and produce clear, complete shift-turnover notes. * Work collaboratively with NOC colleagues, Engineering and other operational teams. **Required Qualifications & Skills** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–2 years of experience in network operations, IT support, or a related technical role; internships or lab experience are considered. * Foundational knowledge of IP networking (TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing and switching concepts), with awareness of BGP, OSPF and MPLS. * Basic understanding of optical transport concepts (DWDM, CWDM, fiber types, optics, patch panels) and optical power levels. * Familiarity with network device command-line interfaces (CLI). * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to follow procedures accurately. * Good written and verbal communication skills, including clear ticket documentation. * Willingness to learn, take direction and escalate appropriately. * Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 shift-based operational environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate-level certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA, Nokia NRS I, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent. * Exposure to multi-vendor network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera). * Basic familiarity with fiber testing tools (OTDR, power meters, light sources). * Experience with NOC monitoring, alarm management and ticketing platforms. * Awareness of ITIL-based incident and change management processes. * Interest in scripting or automation (e.g., Python). **Physical Demands & Work Environment** * Ability to perform office-related tasks, including prolonged sitting or standing. * Capability to move within an office environment and effectively use a computer. * Must have strong communication skills for effective collaboration and coordination. * Occasional repetitive motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers may be required. * Availability to work rotating shifts, including weekends, and holidays as required in a 24x7 environment.

title: SNA Business Development Executive
description: **Role at a glance** Forus Training is looking for an SNA Business Development Executive to grow enrolments on our Special Needs Assisting courses, turning enquiries into learners and building partnerships with schools, employers and community organisations across Ireland. **About Forus Training and the role** Forus Training is a QQI-accredited further education and training provider based in Mullingar. For more than 25 years we have helped learners across Ireland build skills, qualifications and confidence through online, live online and classroom courses in Special Needs Assistance, Early Learning and Care, Health and Social Care, Agriculture, Horticulture and Business. Special Needs Assisting is one of our flagship areas. Our SNA programmes include Special Needs Assisting at QQI Level 5 (5N1786) and Level 6 (6N1957), Understanding Special Needs (5N1709) and Understanding and Assisting Children with Additional Needs (5C21528). Learners can study self-paced, in blended live online groups, or in the classroom, including courses run on-site for schools and organisations. This new role exists to grow the SNA team's numbers. You will own the SNA sales pipeline, from first enquiry to enrolment, and open new routes to learners through schools, ETBs, employers and community partners. You will work with our SNA trainers and coordinators so that what we sell, we deliver well. **What you will do** **Convert enquiries into enrolments** * Follow up SNA enquiries by phone, email and WhatsApp, and guide people to the right course and level. * Explain delivery options (self-paced, blended live online, classroom), entry requirements, fees, payment plans and progression routes, such as Level 5 to Level 6. * Help learners with funding, including TESG and other grant applications, working with our Further Education and Training Advisor. * Manage your pipeline in HubSpot: log every contact, keep deal stages current and hit agreed conversion targets. **Build partnerships and group bookings** * Approach primary, secondary and special schools, ETBs, Education Centres, early years settings and disability services about SNA training for staff. * Sell and arrange on-site and closed-group courses, working with Programme Coordinators on dates, venues and trainers. * Build relationships with Intreo, Local Employment Services, community groups and Family Resource Centres to reach jobseekers and career changers. * Prepare simple proposals and quotes, and support tenders for SNA training with Operations and Finance. **Grow demand with Marketing** * Work with Marketing on SNA campaigns, including Meta and Google ads, course pages, emails and open evenings. * Run information webinars and attend careers fairs and community events. * Feed back what learners ask and what stops them enrolling, so we can improve our messaging and course pages. * Gather learner reviews and success stories from SNA graduates. **Support the SNA team and report on results** * Work with SNA trainers and coordinators so that new intakes are full and course starts run smoothly. * Spot gaps in our SNA offer, such as new locations, times or related courses, and share ideas for new programmes. * Track enquiries, conversion rates, enrolments and revenue by channel, and report weekly to the Managing Director. * Follow our GDPR, quality assurance and learner protection procedures in every sale. **What you will bring** **Essential** * At least two years' experience in sales, business development or student recruitment, ideally in education, training or another service business. * A track record of meeting targets and converting enquiries into customers. * Confident, warm phone manner and clear written communication. * Experience using a CRM, ideally HubSpot, to manage leads and follow-ups. * Strong organisation and follow-through, with the ability to manage many leads at once. * A genuine interest in special needs education and the SNA role in Irish schools. * The right to work in Ireland and the ability to attend our Mullingar office once a week. **Useful but not essential** * Experience as an SNA, or in a school, early years or disability setting. * Knowledge of the Irish education system, the NCSE and the SNA scheme. * Contacts with schools, ETBs, Education Centres or community organisations. * Knowledge of QQI awards and funding such as TESG. * Experience running webinars, open evenings or events. * A full driving licence for visits to schools and partners. **Who will thrive here** You like people and you like a target. You enjoy helping someone find the right next step, and you get real satisfaction when a hesitant enquirer becomes a confident learner. You are organised, you follow up, and you care about doing right by learners as much as about the numbers. **What we offer and how to apply** **What we offer** * A new role with real ownership of growth for one of our flagship course areas. * 30 hours a week with hybrid working, attending our Mullingar office once a week. * Commission on enrolments, on top of your hourly rate. * Purposeful work: every learner you enrol is a step closer to supporting children in Irish schools. **Equal opportunity** Forus Training is committed to an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and can provide reasonable accommodations during recruitment. If you meet most, but not every, requirement and believe you could contribute strongly, we encourage you to apply. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mullingar, County Westmeath

industrial teams * Partner with Account Executives to build outreach strategy for each Named Account, and run smooth hand-off meetings so qualified opportunities move forward without friction * Hit and exceed weekly activity and meeting targets, driving Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) * Track and analyse your prospecting metrics — open rates, reply rates, meeting conversion — and use what you learn to sharpen your approach * Put AI to work every day: using Claude Enterprise to research accounts, map stakeholders and draft personalised outreach, and Gong to learn from your calls and improve your pitch — so more of your time goes into real conversations * Keep every activity, interaction and next step accurately logged in Salesforce and Outreach * A/B test messaging, share what's working, and bring ideas to team meetings that make the whole SDR function stronger **What you bring** * At least 1 year of B2B sales experience, ideally in software or SaaS, with a track record of hitting activity and pipeline targets * Fluent English and French, written and spoken — you'll prospect and qualify confidently in both * A genuine hunter mentality: you moment * Self-motivation, resilience and a strong drive to hit — and beat — your numbers * Resourcefulness when the obvious route doesn't work, and the creativity to find another way in * Strong organisation: you can juggle multiple accounts, sequences and touchpoints without dropping the ball * A coachable, growth-minded approach — you seek out feedback, act on it and keep raising your own bar * Comfort and curiosity with AI in your daily workflow — you already use tools like Claude to work smarter, and you're keen to keep experimenting * Familiarity with a modern sales stack is a plus — Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Claude Enterprise; experience with intent-signal tools like 6sense is highly valued * Ambition to grow into an Account Executive role, and an interest in building the skills to get there * Based in the UK or Ireland, with the right to work in your country of residence We know great SDRs come from all kinds of backgrounds. If you don't tick every box but you love the challenge of starting new conversations — in two languages — we'd love to hear from you. **Why Poka** You'll be prospecting for a product that solves a real problem. Manufacturers and industrial companies are under pressure to capture the knowledge of a retiring workforce, onboard new people faster and get AI onto the floor in a way operators actually use — and Poka already does that at 3,000+ sites. You'll get structured coaching, a modern AI-powered sales stack and a clear path towards closing deals yourself, with the backing of the IFS family behind you. **What we offer:** * Generous vacation policy, additional paid days, and charity day. * Scale-up energy with huge backing and a global yet close-knit team. * A truly flexible schedule and remote-friendly working - including up to 8 weeks a year working from abroad. * Wellbeing support from day one, including free 1:1 sessions with certified coaches and therapists. * MacBook Pro, plus home-office and monthly allowances to set you up properly. * An annual learning and development budget to keep your career moving. * Regular team meetups and industry events - remote never means disconnected. * A rewarding employee referral program for successful hires. *Exact benefits vary by country - we'll walk you through your full local package during the hiring process.* *Want to learn more about our culture? Click HERE.* **Please note:** An understanding of English is essential at Poka, as it is the language used during company-wide meetings and many internal communications, ensuring effective collaboration and decision-making. In addition, as Poka operates in an international environment, English is the primary language for communicating with our clients and partners, enabling us to better serve them and represent Poka in a professional manner.

We dive deep into security technologies such as new access control design patterns, identity security services, access control, authorization, authentication, and life cycle management to support our customers as Amazon continues to scale and grow. We are looking for systems engineering professionals from diverse backgrounds, who are creative problem solvers, and passionate about delivering solutions that improve both user experience and security. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience * Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent * Experience working in a 24/7 production environment * Knowledge of networking fundamentals * This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state * Experience in Linux systems administration and/or development **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge of configuration management systems, such as Puppet, Chef, Ansible, or related systems * Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration * Experience in building scripts, tooling, and automation for large-scale computing environments Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. title: Tax Graduate
description: **Location:** CityWest **Programme Duration:** 3-Year Graduate Programme **Start Date:** 06 September 2027 **End Date:** 05 September 2030 **Role Purpose** We are seeking a motivated and ambitious Tax Graduate to join our Group tax team. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to develop a career in taxation while gaining practical experience across corporate tax, VAT, payroll taxes, transfer pricing, and tax compliance. The successful candidate will work closely with experienced tax professionals, support ongoing tax projects, and assist in ensuring compliance with Irish and international tax obligations. **Key Responsibilities** **Tax Compliance** * Assist with the preparation and review of corporate tax returns and supporting schedules. * Support the preparation and filing of VAT, Intrastat, VIES returns. maintain robust tax governance and control processes. **Process Improvement** * Assist in the identification of opportunities to improve tax compliance processes and reporting efficiency. * Support system enhancements and automation initiatives. * Participate in tax technology and digitalisation projects. **Stakeholder Engagement** * Work collaboratively with Finance, Group Tax, and external advisors. * Build effective working relationships across the organisation. * Communicate tax-related information clearly and professionally. **Essential** **Qualifications and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics or Law. * Strong academic record. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications. * Strong analytical and numerical skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong attention to detail and organisational skills. **Desirable** * Previous internship or placement experience in the tax / finance sector. * Knowledge of Irish tax legislation and tax principles. * Interest in pursuing a professional tax qualification e.g. Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA) of the Irish Tax Institute. **Key Competencies** * Analytical thinking * Problem solving * Attention to detail * Time management * Teamwork and collaboration * Continuous learning mindset * Professionalism and integrity * Effective communication skills **Career Development** **The Successful Candidate Will Receive** * Structured on-the-job training. * Exposure to a broad range of tax disciplines. * Support towards professional tax qualifications. * Mentoring from experienced tax professionals. * Opportunities for progression within the Group Tax function. **What We Offer** * Competitive graduate salary. * Study support for the Chartered Tax Advisor (CTA) qualification of the Irish Tax Institute. * Annual leave and company benefits package. * Hybrid working opportunities. * Continuous professional development and training. * Opportunity to build a long-term career in taxation and finance. **Uniphar Background** Uniphar Group is a rapidly expanding diversified healthcare services business with a global footprint and a proud heritage in Ireland. With a workforce of more than 3,000 spread across Ireland, United Kingdom, Mainland Europe, MENA and the USA, Uniphar is a trusted global partner to pharma and medtech manufacturers, working to improve patient access to medicines and treatments around the world. Uniphar provides outsourced and specialised services to its clients, leveraging the strong relationships with 200+ of the world’s best known pharmaco-medical manufacturers across multiple geographies, enabled by our cutting-edge digital technology and our expert teams. Uniphar is organised into three key divisions: Uniphar Supply Chain & Retail, Uniphar Medtech and Uniphar Pharma. ***Please note that Uniphar is an equal-opportunity employer; we do not discriminate and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.*** Please note that all applications must be submitted by the closing date of **3rd January 2027.**

description: ### **Role Overview** As an **eCommerce Product Engineer**, you will report directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO) and work closely with our wider eCommerce team to build and maintain our online business. You will play a vital role in supporting the technical health and product roadmap of our Shopify store across 10+ international markets. Working alongside the team, you will help bridge the gap between the digital storefront and the physical supply chain, writing code and configuring systems to ensure a seamless customer experience from website to warehouse. This is a role for a hybrid thinker—someone who loves writing code to build great features but also understands the business logic behind an eCommerce conversion. Shopify Engineering & Product UX** * **Site Development:** Collaborate with the team to build, test, and deploy daily site updates. Assist in testing new features, configuring third-party apps, and debugging design tweaks across mobile and desktop. * **User Journey Optimization:** Treat the website as a product. Help the team monitor the path-to-purchase to identify technical friction points (e.g., broken scripts, slow load times, checkout errors) and assist in shipping solutions to fix them. **2. Systems Integration & Data Flow** * **Data Architecture:** Support the maintenance of our product data. You will help monitor and update the workflows that keep Shopify stock levels accurate to prevent overselling. * **Technical Troubleshooting:** Investigate order flow issues as they arise—digging into the backend to figure out why a webhook failed, why an order didn't sync to the warehouse ERP, or why automated tracking emails didn't fire. **3. Multi-Market Technical Architecture** * **International Infrastructure:** Support the backend configuration for our 10+ localized sites. You will help manage the technical apps, Shopify Markets settings, and translation workflows that serve customized content to different regions. * **Localization QA:** Work with the team to ensure the logic dictating currency conversions, regional shipping rates, and localized content triggers correctly for users in Germany, France, Spain, etc. ### **Required Qualifications & Skills** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree (Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related). * **Experience:** 0–2 years of experience.
